enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +5: Passive: +5 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Charisma +4: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Devotion +59: Passive: +59 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Anthem: When equipped by a character with Bard levels, this item begins to hum an inspiring tune. Your bard songs regenerate slowly over time.

Silver: A complex process involving metallurgy and alchemy can bond silver to a weapon made of steel so that it bypasses the damage reduction of creatures such as devils and vampires. Silver weapons have 2 points lower hardness then equivalent steel weapons, and as such aren't quite as durable.
